said: The Bank of England's real responses, recorded by meridian-bank-of-england's authors on 2026-11-19: its Statistical Interactive Database's CSV of SONIA (IUDSOIA) with its 10th, 25th, 75th and 90th percentiles (IUDZLS6 to IUDZLS9), the SONIA Compounded Index (IUDZOS2) and Bank Rate (IUDBEDR), and of its 27 spot exchange rates against sterling, each from 3 August to 19 November 2026, the body gzipped; and its latest yield curve file, the zip of the current month's workbooks (2 to 18 November 2026), as received. Reproduction of the Database's data is subject to the UK Open Government Licence; SONIA and/or SONIA Compounded Index data licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and copyright the Governor and Company of the Bank of England; selected exchange rate data are excluded from that licence, and the yield curves' inputs are Bloomberg Finance L.P.'s and Tradeweb's (https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/legal, https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/statistics/yield-curves). Sample data answers each request from them, and the tests read them.
